_comment: Manual central-bank policy-rate fallback, read by fetch_macro.py. Used ALWAYS for IN (no reliable FRED series exists for RBI's repo rate) and as a fallback for US/UK/JP if FRED_KEY is unset or the FRED call fails. Update after each central-bank meeting; two-source-check before editing.

IN.note: Repo rate, held at 5.25% (unchanged since the 2025-12-05 cut from 5.50%). Next MPC meeting: 2026-08-03/05.

US.note: Midpoint of the FOMC's target range, held at 3.50%–3.75% since the 2026-06-17 meeting.

UK.note: Bank Rate, held at 3.75% (7–2 vote) at the meeting ending 2026-06-17, announced 2026-06-18.

JP.note: Policy rate, raised 25bp to 1.00% (7–1 vote) on 2026-06-16 — highest since 1995.
